mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.type, c.scope, c.threshold, c.amount, c.discount, c.total_count AS totalCount, c.received_count AS receivedCount, (c.total_count - c.received_count) AS remainCount, c.per_limit AS perLimit, c.start_time AS startTime, c.end_time AS endTime, c.description FROM coupon c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND (c.start_time IS NULL OR c.start_time <= #{now}) AND (c.end_time IS NULL OR c.end_time > #{now}) ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.type, c.scope, c.threshold, c.amount, c.discount, c.total_count AS totalCount, c.received_count AS receivedCount, (c.total_count - c.received_count) AS remainCount, c.per_limit AS perLimit, c.start_time AS startTime, c.end_time AS endTime, c.status, c.description, c.create_time AS createTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_coupon uc WHERE uc.deleted = 0 AND uc.coupon_id = c.id) AS receiveRecordCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_coupon uc WHERE uc.deleted = 0 AND uc.coupon_id = c.id AND uc.status = 1) AS usedCount FROM coupon c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS couponTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activeCoupon, COALESCE(SUM(total_count), 0) AS issuedTotal, COALESCE(SUM(received_count), 0) AS receivedTotal FROM coupon WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT c.type AS type, COUNT(c.id) AS couponCount, COALESCE(SUM(c.received_count), 0) AS receivedCount, COALESCE(SUM(u.usedCount), 0) AS usedCount FROM coupon c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT coupon_id, COUNT(*) AS usedCount FROM user_coupon WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY coupon_id ) u ON u.coupon_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.type ORDER BY c.type ASC
